robot: Franka Emika Panda arm with the Franka Hand parallel gripper on a fixed base, driven by EmbodiedSWE's operational-space (torque) controller

frame.suite: the simulator's world frame (metres, z up)
frame.base_text: the arm's base (panda_link0), at the world origin with the world's axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up

arm.note: end-effector pose = the panda_hand frame; joint_positions = the two finger position targets (m each, 0 closed, 0.04 open)

ee.point: the panda_hand frame (the hand's flange); the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m further along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis
ee.mode_text: a streamed pose target that the operational-space controller tracks; move_robot interpolates the path at about 0.15 m/s

notes: The arm takes end-effector poses only, tracked by EmbodiedSWE's operational-space (torque) controller; its seven joints take no direct command. The end-effector pose is the panda_hand frame, not the fingertips: the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis from it, so for a top-down grasp put panda_hand 0.1034 m above the grasp point. The arm's two joint_positions are the finger position targets (finger_1, finger_2, metres each: 0 = closed, 0.04 = open): send both together, e.g. [0.04, 0.04] to open and [0.0, 0.0] to close; a closed target on an object squeezes it. gripper_opening_m in the state is the measured distance between the finger pads (about 0.08 fully open). The measured joint angles are in observe's proprio_now (its layout: describe_robot's spec_file, proprio_layout). One episode, no reset; it ends by itself once the task is complete.

An arm's two joint_positions are its finger position targets (finger_1, finger_2, metres each: 0 = closed, 0.04 = open): send both together, e.g. [0.04, 0.04] to open and [0.0, 0.0] to close; a closed target on an object squeezes it. gripper_opening_m is the measured distance between that hand's finger pads (about 0.08 fully open). patch.robot: Unitree G1 humanoid with two Dex3 three-finger hands, pelvis fixed to the world, upper body driven by EmbodiedSWE's Pink IK

frame.base_text: the pelvis: origin at the pelvis, +X the way the pelvis faces, +Y to the robot's left, +Z up (levelled)

left.note: end-effector pose = the left wrist (left_wrist_yaw_link frame); the palm and fingers extend beyond it

ee.point: the left wrist (left_wrist_yaw_link frame origin); the palm and fingers extend beyond it
ee.mode_text: a streamed wrist target for Pink IK (waist and both arms solved together); move_robot interpolates the path at about 0.15 m/s

right.note: end-effector pose = the right wrist (right_wrist_yaw_link frame); the palm and fingers extend beyond it

ee.point: the right wrist (right_wrist_yaw_link frame origin); the palm and fingers extend beyond it
ee.mode_text: a streamed wrist target for Pink IK (waist and both arms solved together); move_robot interpolates the path at about 0.15 m/s

hands.note: the 14 Dex3 hand joint targets (rad) of both hands, in the order listed (each name says its hand and finger)

patch.notes: Each arm takes its wrist pose (the left_wrist_yaw_link / right_wrist_yaw_link frame; the palm and fingers extend beyond it). EmbodiedSWE's Pink IK solves the waist and both arms (17 joints) for the two wrist targets together, so moving one wrist can shift the waist and the other arm a little. The pelvis is fixed to the world (the legs are locked). The part hands takes the 14 Dex3 hand joint targets (rad) of both hands in the order describe_robot lists them (each joint's name says its hand and finger): send all 14, copying the current targets (observe: parts.hands.joint_positions) for the joints you leave alone. There is no single gripper value: close and open a hand through its joint targets (their limits: describe_robot's spec_file, action_types.ee_pose.joint_limits); a target past a joint's limit presses the joint against it. Each arm's gripper_opening_m is the distance from that hand's thumb tip to the midpoint of its index and middle fingertips. The measured joint angles are in observe's proprio_now (its layout: describe_robot's spec_file, proprio_layout). One episode, no reset; it ends by itself once the task is complete.

patch.robot: Unitree G1 humanoid with two Dex3 three-finger hands, upper body driven by EmbodiedSWE's Pink IK, legs walked by a locomotion policy

locomotion.note: A locomotion policy walks the legs at the commanded forward / sideways speed (m/s) and turn rate (rad/s) in the robot's own frame and holds the pelvis at the standing height (m, 0.72 by default; the policy clips each value to its own range). The wrist targets stay where they were in the world while it walks, so the hands trail behind a walking body: walk with empty hands, or carry with execute_trajectory space native, moving the wrist targets along with the base in each row.

patch.notes: Each arm takes its wrist pose (the left_wrist_yaw_link / right_wrist_yaw_link frame; the palm and fingers extend beyond it). EmbodiedSWE's Pink IK solves the waist and both arms (17 joints) for the two wrist targets together, so moving one wrist can shift the waist and the other arm a little. The robot walks with locomote (a locomotion policy drives the legs). Wrist targets are world poses: they do not follow the body while it walks. The part hands takes the 14 Dex3 hand joint targets (rad) of both hands in the order describe_robot lists them (each joint's name says its hand and finger): send all 14, copying the current targets (observe: parts.hands.joint_positions) for the joints you leave alone. There is no single gripper value: close and open a hand through its joint targets (their limits: describe_robot's spec_file, action_types.ee_pose.joint_limits). Each arm's gripper_opening_m is the distance from that hand's thumb tip to the midpoint of its index and middle fingertips. The measured joint angles are in observe's proprio_now (its layout: describe_robot's spec_file, proprio_layout). One episode, no reset; it ends by itself once the task is complete.
